name: Clay County, MS
findings: Clay County has 47 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Clay County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Clay County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
